text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
After spending the day out with Super<n>Creek, I head
over to the library.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I've been taking it easy as I study<n>different training
methods—just as I<n>promised to Super Creek. Then
one<n>day...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: We did it, Trainer! My time has<n>improved!
choice_data_list: It's because you've been working so hard, Creek!
It's because you've been working so hard, Creek!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I'm so glad all our hard work is<n>paying off. Hehe!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: ...Oh? Look, Trainer. Over there...

text_block_list.name: Short-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Huff... puff... Trainer... I-I'm sorry Ican't manage... a better time...

text_block_list.name: Serious Trainer
text_block_list.text:
It's not your fault. It's mine for<n>lacking the power
to support you as a<n>trainer.

text_block_list.name: Serious Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Let's call it a day. I'll think of a new<n>training plan
for next time.

text_block_list.name: Short-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Then, um... I'll also...

text_block_list.name: Short-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Actually, never mind... Thank you for<n>today.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: It's that trainer from before.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Serious Trainer
text_block_list.text: Sigh... What do I even do? This is allmy fault. At this rate, she—
choice_data_list: You should talk to her some more.

text_block_list.name: Serious Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me? And who asked for—oh,<n>it's you two...
You were listening?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Sorry. We happened to overhear your<n>conversation.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Still... I agree with my trainer.

text_block_list.name: Serious Trainer
text_block_list.text:
This is none of your business. It's<n>my own inability
that's to blame. I<n>don't intend to point any fingers
at<n>my trainee.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Well, we're making it our business. I<n>just want to
tell you that you're<n>wrong.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure she's worried about you<n>and wants to
talk with you about it,<n>just like I do with my trainer.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
She wants to better understand your<n>hardships and
share them with you.

text_block_list.name: Serious Trainer
text_block_list.text: ...My hardships?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Yes, I'm sure of it.

text_block_list.name: Serious Trainer
text_block_list.text: But I could never put that on her...
choice_data_list: Some things can't be solved on your own.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
If you two gain a deeper<n>understanding of each
other, you<n>might also be able to find a solution to
your problems.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
She isn't just an athlete whose sole<n>purpose is to
run—Umamusume are<n>more than that.

text_block_list.name: Serious Trainer
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. You might be right. Thanks. I'll<n>start by
trying to talk to her.

text_block_list.name: Serious Trainer
text_block_list.text:
And... I'm sorry for all the mean<n>things I said
before.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I think our little talk with that other<n>trainer...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Will help her to form a good<n>relationship with her
Umamusume—just like the one we<n>have.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
You really are kind. Who's a good<n>trainer?! Yes,
you are! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
While it's important to share a bond, I<n>feel like I'm
being spoiled a bit too<n>much. I need to reflect on my
actions.<n>From now on...
choice_data_list: I won't allow myself to be spoiled anymore!
I will become a more dependable trainer!
I'll be the one doing the pampering!
I'll be the one doing the pampering!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
While it's important to share a bond, I<n>feel like I'm
being spoiled a bit too<n>much. I need to reflect on my
actions.<n>From now on...
choice_data_list: I won't allow myself to be spoiled anymore!
I will become a more dependable trainer!
I'll be the one doing the pampering!
I'll be the one doing the pampering!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Huuuuh? But why?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
No... I can't bear the thought of no<n>longer being able
to pamper you...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: It's just too sad... Too lonely... It's<n>making me cry...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I won't be able to work hard duringtraining... Sniffle.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I panic and take back what I had just<n>said, only to
notice a cheeky grin<n>spreading across Super
Creek's<n>face.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. If you become any more<n>reliable, I won't be
able to take care<n>of you any longer.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Still, I know there are people out there<n>who don't
know how truly reliable<n>you are.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I'll just have to show my trainer off<n>to the world
through my races.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I can't wait for the day when<n>everybody discovers
how incredible<n>you are! ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Goodness gracious! You? Pampering<n>me? That
must mean...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: You'll let me spoil you to the moon<n>and back, right?!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hehehe, that makes me so happy.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Always such a sweet little cutie,<n>aren't you? I'll
keep spoiling you<n>rotten! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I try to say otherwise, but Super<n>Creek pretends not
to hear me.
